planSteps.description: Find the password input field and enter 'My-Drop-Site' to unlock the site.
Navigate to /auth. Verify the login/signup page loads with email and password fields.
Enter a fake email like 'hacker@test.com' and wrong password 'wrongpass'. Click login. Verify an error message appears and login fails.

planSteps.step: Test XSS in login email field
planSteps.description: Enter '<script>alert(1)</script>' in the email field and try to submit. Verify no JavaScript alert pops up and the input is handled safely.
Enter "' OR 1=1 --" in the email field and any password. Try to login. Verify login fails with proper error message.
Navigate to /contact. Enter '' in the name and message fields. Submit the form. Verify no script executes.
On /contact, enter an invalid email like 'not-an-email' in the email field. Try to submit. Verify email validation catches the invalid format.
Navigate to /search. Enter '<script>alert(1)</script>' in the search input. Verify no alert pops up and the search handles it safely.
Navigate to /admin without being logged in. Verify the page redirects to login or shows an access denied message.
Navigate to /auth, switch to signup mode. Enter a valid email but a password shorter than 6 characters like '123'. Try to sign up. Verify a validation error appears.
Navigate to /contact. Enter a very long string (500+ characters) in the message field. Verify the form handles it without crashing.
On /contact, enter special characters like '<>&"\/' in the name and subject fields. Verify they are accepted or sanitized without errors.
